fil: Si Ana ay may pusa. Mabait ang pusa ni Ana. Masaya silang maglaro.
Si Ana ay may bola. Pula ang bola. Naglaro siya.

Maagang gumising si Ana. Inilagay niya ang libro sa bag. Kumain siya ng saging. Naglakad siya papunta sa paaralan kasama si Nanay. Sa silid-aralan, tinulungan niya si Ben na magbasa. Natuwa si Ben at nagpasalamat.

May maliit na halaman si Lito. Natuyo ang lupa sa paso. Kumuha siya ng tubig at diniligan ang halaman. Inilagay niya ito malapit sa bintana. Pagkaraan ng ilang araw, may bagong dahon. Masaya si Lito dahil lumago ang halaman.
en: Ana has a cat. Her cat is kind. They are happy when they play together.
Sam has a bag. The bag is red. Sam is glad.
Sam woke up early. He put a book in his bag. He ate an apple. He walked to school with Dad. In class, Sam helped Mia read a story. Mia smiled and said thank you.
Lily had a small plant. The soil in its pot was dry. She got water and watered the plant. She put it by a sunny window. After a few days, a new leaf grew. Lily was happy to see her plant grow.
